##### 1. Persona snapshot

| Aspect | Detail |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Who** | An independent or firm-based commercial real estate broker. They hold space to lease or sell on behalf of landlords. |
| **Goals** | List space, find brands and tenants who want it, and get contact details quickly. |
| **How onboarded** | Self-serve. Phone number and one-time code, choose "Property Agent", complete a short profile. Signed in straight away. |
| **Subscription** | Agents are the **only** persona that can buy a subscription. |
| **Asset-class scope** | The agent chooses asset classes at sign-up (Retail, F&B, Office, Managed Space). Properties are limited to those classes. Demands are not class-limited. |
| **Account states** | Registered (free), Subscribed, Expiring soon (within 7 days of renewal) and Expired. |

###### What an agent can do

- **Post properties** (1 free, then needs paid coverage for that city and asset class).
- **Post demands** (a requirement for a client). The first free listing is shared with properties, see [Section 5](#5-limits-and-rules).
- **See matches:** relevant demands for each property, and relevant properties and projects for any demand they own.
- **Reveal contact numbers** (5 free, then unlimited inside paid coverage).
- **Send and answer enquiries** and image requests.
- **Buy, extend, cancel and renew** a subscription, and download invoices.
- **Manage their own account:** profile, notification choices, deactivate, delete request.

###### What an agent cannot do

| Blocked action | Why |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Browse the demand marketplace** | Demands are private. Agents reach a demand only through a match with one of their own live properties. |
| **See who posted a demand** | The poster's name, brand and company are always hidden. Contact comes only through an accepted request. |
| **Post in a city not covered** | When subscribed, posting is limited to covered city and package pairs. |
| **Buy Managed Space coverage** | Managed Space is not sold by subscription. |
| **Use developer, brand or tenant features** | Different roles. |
| **Subscribe on the iOS app** | Purchase screens are hidden there (see [Flow 21](#flow-21--subscribe-pay-and-activate)). |

###### Paywalls at a glance

| Moment | Free agent | Subscribed agent (covered) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Post a property or demand | 1 in total | Unlimited in covered city and package pairs |
| Reveal a phone number | 5 in total | Unlimited in covered pairs |
| Request hidden photos | Allowed | Allowed |

---

##### 2. Screen and navigation map

###### Menu items an agent sees

| Menu item | Where it goes | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Home** | Landing page and city feed | |
| **Explore Properties** ("Explore" on the bottom bar) | Search, filtered to the chosen city | Agents explore properties, not demands. |
| **Projects** | Search, projects view | |
| **Post Property** | Property form | |
| **Post Demand** | Demand form | |
| **Dashboard** | Own listings, leads, matches | |
| **Profile** | Profile, preferences, plan summary | |
| **Saved** | Favourites | |
| **Notifications** | Notification centre, with unread badge | |
| **Subscription** ("My Plan" on iOS) | Plan builder, or the current plan | Hidden for other roles. |
| **Agent Subscription** (drawer banner) | Plan builder | Disappears once the agent has paid. |
| **Enterprise Solution** (drawer) | Enterprise enquiry page | Hidden on iOS. |

**Not shown to agents:** Leads (Keydemand team only), Explore Demands (Keydemand team only), Relationship Manager (enterprise accounts only), Add Centre (retired).

###### Dashboard areas

The dashboard shows tabs. The exact set was read from the page definition, and the order should be confirmed in the running app **(inferred)**.

| Tab | What it shows |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Overview** | Counts for listings, leads, favourites, matches and the plan, plus an "Unfinished listings, pick up where you left off" banner for drafts. |
| **Properties** | The agent's listings. Each has Edit, Activate or Deactivate, and Delete. A filter by asset class and status. |
| **Demands** | The agent's own demands. |
| **Leads (received)** | Contact requests, image requests and "phone numbers viewed" on the agent's listings. |
| **Enquiries (sent)** | Projects enquired, numbers the agent has viewed, contacts requested, images requested. |
| **Relevancy panel and updates** | Counts of relevant demands, properties and projects, with the scorer version. |

###### Mobile versus desktop

| Surface | Experience |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Desktop** | Pill bar, profile dropdown, full dashboard. |
| **Phone** | Bottom bar (Home, Explore, Menu, Profile), drawer with the rest. |
| **iOS app** | Plan builder, prices and Subscribe buttons are removed. "My Plan" shows the plan the agent already holds, renewal date and past invoices. The free tier stays fully usable. |

---

##### 3. End-to-end flows

###### Flow 1 — Sign up as an agent

- **Actor:** New broker.
- **Prerequisites:** A mobile number that receives SMS.

1. The visitor enters their 10-digit number and ticks the over-18 and Terms consent.
2. For an unknown number, they pick **Property Agent** on the role screen.
3. A 6-digit code arrives by SMS. They enter it. (Resend after 30 seconds. At most 3 sends in 5 minutes.)
4. The **agent profile form** opens, with the phone number locked.
   - **Required:** Full Name, City, Asset Classes (one or more), Transaction Type (lease, buy or both).
   - **Optional:** Email, About Yourself.
5. Wrong entries are shown inline: "Please enter a valid email address", and a red marker on any missing required field. A server error shows in a pop-up.
6. They submit. The account is created and they are signed in. Terms and over-18 consent are stamped with the time.
7. A success screen shows the journey **Post, Get matched, Connect, Close**, with a button to start exploring. A user who came from a listing is returned there.

**System side-effects**

- A welcome message goes out on WhatsApp and by email, with a toast and a Complete profile button.
- If the profile stays incomplete, a WhatsApp nudge and a toast follow after 24 hours, with a Complete profile button.
- The abandoned-sign-up marker is cleared.
- An email address, if given, must be real: valid format, not a disposable inbox, and a domain that accepts mail.

**Edge cases**

- The profile photo is set from **Profile**, not at sign-up. The sign-up form shows a photo picker; confirm in the running app whether the photo is saved at this step **(inferred: the server drops it at registration)**.
- States and a cities list can be added later in the profile.
- The older requirements say email is mandatory before posting. The code makes it optional and has no email-verification step.

###### Flow 2 — Log in, session and log out

- **Actor:** Returning agent.

1. The agent enters their number and consent, then the 6-digit code.
2. They land on the page they came from, or on the home page.
3. The session refreshes quietly in the background while the app is used.
4. They can log out from the profile menu. Logging out forgets the device for push alerts.

**Error messages**

| Situation | What the user sees |
| :---- | :---- |
| Wrong code | "Invalid code." |
| Expired code | "Your code expired. Tap Resend for a new one." |
| Too many wrong tries | "Too many attempts. Request a new code." |
| Too many resends | "Please wait N seconds" or "Try again in N seconds." |
| Account removed | "This account has been removed. Contact support." |
| Deactivated by Keydemand | A login pop-up explains and asks them to contact support. |
| Deactivated by the agent | They **can** sign in, and see a "Reactivate account" prompt (see [Flow 26](#flow-26--deactivate-or-reactivate-the-account)). |

**Edge cases:** an expired session during use triggers a silent refresh. If that fails, the agent is returned to sign-in, then back to where they were. A removed account is also refused on refresh.

###### Flow 3 — Complete and edit the profile

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. Open **Profile**, then **Edit Profile**.
2. The profile has three groups: Personal Details, Business Details and Preferences.
3. **Editable:** name, email, profile picture, About Yourself, designation, experience, states, cities, asset classes, transaction types, company name, RERA number, "member of a realtor body" and "show other agent demand".
4. **Not editable:** mobile number (shown as "cannot be changed"), role.
5. **Rules:** RERA number allows letters, digits, "/" and "-", up to 60 characters. Designation needs at least one letter. A bad value shows an inline error. Leaving the page with unsaved changes asks "Discard your changes?", and saving asks "Save these changes?".
6. The profile photo is a JPG or PNG up to 2 MB.

**System side-effects:** changing the agent's asset classes changes what they may post. Editing cities and asset classes changes the matches, the match alerts and the new-demand alerts for those cities.

**Edge cases:** an agent who clears their email is allowed. The "show other agent demand" switch exists on the profile. What it changes on screen is not documented, so confirm it **(inferred)**.

###### Flow 4 — Notification preferences

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. Open **Profile, Preferences**, or the notification page.
2. Three switches: **Push**, **WhatsApp** and **Email** notifications. The notification page also has "WhatsApp Promotional Updates", separate from transactional WhatsApp.
3. Switching a channel off stops messages on that channel. In-app messages always stay.
4. The notification page also links to a Help Desk contact.

**System side-effects:** the dispatcher checks consent per channel before each message. Bounced email addresses are suppressed.

###### Flow 5 — Choose a city, search and explore

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. The agent picks a city in the header. The choice is remembered.
2. **Explore Properties** opens search for that city. They add filters: asset class, lease or buy, locality, and class-specific ranges.
3. Results show properties and projects. Photos are visible (unless the owner hid them).
4. They can search by a Keydemand listing ID or an old v1 listing number.
5. A listing is shown only if its "Who can see this" setting allows agents, and does not exclude agents.
6. Nearby cities in the same region are included in the pool.

**Edge cases:** an agent never sees demands in search. A property posted by a colleague is visible only if its audience includes agents. The agent's own properties always show.

###### Flow 6 — Save and review favourites

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. Tap the heart on a property or project card or detail page.
2. Open **Saved** to see all favourites, split into properties and projects.
3. Tap the heart again to remove.

**System side-effects:** favourite counts show on the dashboard.

**Edge cases:** the old "Favorites" address redirects to Saved. There is no saved-search feature.

###### Flow 7 — Post a property

- **Actor:** Agent.
- **Prerequisites:** Signed in. Either the free listing is unused, or the plan covers the chosen city and asset class.

1. Open **Post Property**. An agent is never redirected away from it. (Brands, tenants and occupiers are sent to Post Demand.)
2. Choose an **asset class** from the agent's registered classes. The form then shows that class's fields.
3. Fill the **primary details:** transaction type (lease or buy), city, location (a picked place or a pasted map link), carpet area and class-specific fields such as floor, ceiling height, frontage, store type, cooking type, seats, cabins, possession and fit-out.
4. Fill the **commercials:** rent or price, deposit, lock-in, lease tenure, escalation, maintenance charges.
5. Add **photos.** At least one photo in each of three groups is required: **interior, exterior and front side.** JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each.
6. Optionally add **documents** (PDF, up to 10 MB) and **videos** (MP4 or MOV, up to 20 MB, at most 3 uploads plus 3 video links).
7. Mark any photo as **hidden** if buyers must ask for access.
8. Submit.
9. **Production:** the listing is saved as "waiting for approval". It is not live until Keydemand approves. **Test environments:** it goes live straight away.
10. A Property posted message is sent on WhatsApp and by email (property PDF attached), with a toast and a View property button, and the listing shows on the dashboard.

**Validation and errors (plain words)**

| Situation | What the user sees |
| :---- | :---- |
| Asset class not in the agent's list | The agent's registered asset classes do not include this one. |
| Free listing used, no plan | "Free listing limit (1) reached. Activate a subscription to post more." |
| Plan does not cover the city or class | "Your subscription does not cover this city / asset class. Add coverage to post here." |
| Missing photo group | "Missing required image categories", naming the group. |
| Carpet area missing (not Managed Space) | "Carpet area is required for this asset class." |
| Managed Space with a sale | "Managed space supports lease only." |
| Deposit or lock-in out of range | Inline message (deposit up to 36 months; lock-in cannot outlast the lease). |
| Video limit | "A listing can have at most 3 uploaded videos" or "3 video links". |
| City not served | The city must be an active served city, not a region name. |
| Map pin outside the city | The pin must fall inside the chosen city or region. |

**System side-effects**

- A listing ID is assigned at creation, with an asset-class prefix.
- A free-tier agent's free-listing counter goes up by one. It is counted only after a successful save.
- A "Property posted" message goes out on WhatsApp and email (property PDF attached), with a toast and a View property button.
- The "free limit reached" notice goes out when the limit is hit (see [Flow 20](#flow-20--hit-a-free-limit)).
- Matching to demands begins. Relevant demands appear on the property page, and match alerts go out as they happen (see section 4).
- A prompt can offer to save an unfinished form as a draft ([Flow 9](#flow-9--save-and-resume-a-draft)).

**Edge cases**

- A first-time agent with no plan can post once. That one free listing is **shared** between properties and demands.
- If a subscription is active but does not cover a city, even a free listing is not used. The agent must add coverage.
- A KD-only "Who can see this" audience is dropped on agent posts. Agent listings are open to everyone.

###### Flow 8 — Edit a property

- **Actor:** Agent, as owner.

1. Open the property, then **Edit**.
2. The edit form is the same component as the post form, filled with stored values.
3. Change any allowed field and save.
4. **Locks:** after the listing receives its **first response** (an enquiry or request), four fields lock: **asset class, transaction type, city and location.** Locked fields show as read-only. Everything else, including price, stays editable.
5. A price edit merges into the stored commercials. Clearing a single price field leaves the rest alone.

**System side-effects:** a Property edited message goes out on WhatsApp and email (revised property PDF attached), with a toast and a View property button. Edits do not send the listing back for review, even for major changes **(verified: re-moderation on edit is designed but not built)**.

###### Flow 9 — Save and resume a draft

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. While posting, the agent leaves the form part-way.
2. The partial form is stored as a draft, without validation.
3. The dashboard shows "Unfinished listings, pick up where you left off".
4. Tapping a draft re-opens the form with the saved values.
5. A draft can be deleted.

**Edge cases:** the 30-day automatic draft clean-up is **not built**. Drafts stay until deleted.

###### Flow 10 — Hide photos and approve image requests

- **Actor:** Agent as owner, and any signed-in user as requester.

1. **Hide:** on a property the owner marks chosen photos as hidden (at post or edit). Visitors and other users then see "Images hidden by the owner". But keydemand team member can see the photo.
2. **Request:** a signed-in user taps **Request images**. A dialog explains: their number is shared with the owner, the owner decides, and they are told when approved.
3. **Owner is notified** on push, WhatsApp and in-app (an action-needed alert).
4. **Owner responds** from Dashboard, Leads, Image requests: **Accept** or **Reject.**
5. **On accept:** the requester can see every photo on that property from then on. They are notified.
6. **On reject:** the requester is notified. Hidden photos stay hidden.
7. The requester sees "Image request pending" while waiting and "Request approved" afterwards.

**Edge cases:** a request expires after 72 hours with no answer. A duplicate request shows "You have already sent this request". The owner cannot request their own photos. A request on a listing that has since gone inactive is closed, and the requester is told.

###### Flow 11 — Property status changes, delete and PDF

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. **Deactivate:** from the property page or dashboard. A confirm dialog titled "Deactivate Listing?" appears. The listing leaves the marketplace, and open enquiries on it are closed.
2. **Activate:** the same control reverses it. A listing that was never approved cannot be switched on ("waiting for Keydemand approval"). A reactivated listing does not need a new review.
3. **Mark sold or rented:** allowed by the system (sold or rented removes the listing from the marketplace). The web app does not show a dedicated control **(inferred)**.
4. **Delete:** "Delete Listing?" confirm. The listing is hidden everywhere (soft delete) and open enquiries close.
5. **Download PDF:** a branded property PDF is generated, then cached for repeat downloads.

**System side-effects:** linked requests on the listing close. No notification is sent for deactivating or deleting a property under the current rules (see section 4).

###### Flow 12 — Post a demand

- **Actor:** Agent, for a client or own need.
- **Prerequisites:** The free listing is unused, or the plan covers the chosen city and asset class. (Managed Space demands skip the subscription check.)

1. Open **Post Demand**. The form is shared with brands and tenants.
2. Choose the asset class, transaction type, city and interested localities (plus optional extra locations).
3. Fill the requirement: area range, budget, possession, class-specific needs, required documents at accept time.
4. Submit.
5. In production the demand waits for approval. In test environments it goes live.
6. A demand ID is created, with an asset-class prefix.

**Rules**

- A free-tier agent shares **one** free listing between properties and demands.
- A subscribed agent must post inside covered city and package pairs ("Your subscription does not cover ... add coverage to post here").
- A demand posted by an agent is exempt from high-value routing, so other agents can see it. Its audience is fixed to agents and Keydemand.
- Demands no longer expire.

**System side-effects:** a Demand posted message (in-app and push, with a toast). Matching to properties begins. The free-listing counter goes up when it applies.

**Edge cases:** an agent cannot choose the demand audience. Other agents see an agent's demand without the poster's identity, in the same way as any demand.

###### Flow 13 — Edit, deactivate, fulfil and delete a demand

- **Actor:** Agent, as owner.

1. **Edit:** same shared form. The four identity fields lock after the first response.
2. **Fulfil:** mark the requirement as met. It leaves matching.
3. **Deactivate:** pauses it. Reactivation brings it back.
4. **Delete:** soft delete.
5. Any ending of a demand closes open requests and withdraws any high-value lead tied to it.

**System side-effects:** an edit sends a Demand edited message (in-app and push, with a Changes saved toast). Deactivating, fulfilling or deleting a demand sends no notification under the current rules (see section 4).

###### Flow 14 — See matches and "% Match"

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. Open one of the agent's live properties. A **Relevant Demands** rail lists demands that match.
2. Each card shows a percentage match. Below 50% is hidden.
3. Opening a demand shows **requirement fields only.** There is never a poster name, brand, company, logo, picture, or any lead or view counter.
4. To get in touch, the agent sends a request (Flow 16). The poster's contact is revealed only on acceptance.
5. A demand shows only if it is live and its audience includes agents. High-value demands held by Keydemand stay hidden until released.
6. Similarly, for a demand the agent owns, rails show **Relevant Properties** and **Relevant Projects.**

**How the % is worked out:** hard filters first (live, same lease or sale, compatible asset class, same city, within 3 km of a requested location, area within 75 to 125 percent). Then weighted rows per asset class (for example Office is 40 percent location and 40 percent area). Price is not scored.

**System side-effects:** the dashboard shows counts of relevant demands, properties and projects. New matches are sent as they happen (WhatsApp, in-app, push and toast), with a View relevancy button.

###### Flow 15 — Reveal a contact number

- **Actor:** Agent, as requester.

1. Open a property or an allowed demand and tap **View number**.
2. If already revealed, it shows again at no cost.
3. The system checks the listing is live and that the agent is allowed to see it. Otherwise they see "This listing is no longer available".
4. **Subscribed and covered:** the number reveals at once.
5. **Free tier:** one of 5 free reveals is used.
6. **Free tier exhausted:** the agent sees "Free contact-request limit (5) reached, activate a subscription to continue", plus the subscribe prompt.
7. **Subscribed but not covered:** "Subscription doesn't cover this city / asset class, add coverage to unlock."
8. A pop-up shows the revealed contact.

**Paths by target**

| Target | What happens |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Property** | Immediate reveal. The owner is notified, and the agent appears as a lead on the owner's side. |
| **Demand** | Reveal goes through a request to the poster in some cases (brand demands need approval). An agent may see a demand only if its audience includes agents. |
| **Demand held by Keydemand for a brand** | The Keydemand member's number is shown under the brand's name. No approval step. |

**System side-effects**

- The free counter goes up for free reveals.
- The owner gets a "Your number was viewed" alert as it happens (WhatsApp, in-app, push and toast).
- A "free limit reached" notice goes out the first time the limit is hit, at most once per week.

**Edge cases:** an earlier reveal always stays revealed, even if the listing later changes audience. The owner of a listing is never refused. A reveal on the agent's own listing is instant and free.

###### Flow 16 — Send an enquiry or request

- **Actor:** Agent, as initiator.

1. From a property, demand or project, tap **Enquire**, **Request contact**, **Request images** or **Show Interest**.
2. The request goes to the owner. It carries the agent's name and phone number, and an optional email.
3. The agent sees the request under Dashboard, Enquiries (sent). When the owner answers a contact request, the agent is notified on WhatsApp, in-app, push and toast (View phone number). When an image request is answered, the agent is notified on WhatsApp, in-app and push (View property). Showing interest in a project gives an in-app, push and toast confirmation.
4. The request expires after 72 hours if nobody answers.

**Types of request**

| Type | Purpose | On accept |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Property enquiry | Contact a property owner | Both sides see each other's contact |
| Demand match | Offer a property to a demand | Both sides see each other's contact |
| Image request | Ask for hidden photos | Photos unlocked |
| Project enquiry | Contact a developer | Both sides see each other's contact |
| Contact request | A "View number" that needs approval | Number revealed |
| Project interest | "Show Interest" on a project | Goes to the Keydemand project owner |

**Errors:** "You have already sent this request." "Cannot create an enquiry on your own listing." "This listing is no longer available."

###### Flow 17 — Answer received requests

- **Actor:** Agent, as owner.

1. An image request arrives as an alert on WhatsApp, in-app and push, with a Review request button. Other received requests show in Leads; the current rules have no agent alert for them.
2. Open Dashboard, Leads (received). Filter by contact requests, image requests, status.
3. **Accept:** contact is shared, or photos are granted. The requester is told.
4. **Reject:** the requester is told. Nothing is shared.
5. If nobody acts for 72 hours, the request expires.

**Edge cases:** only the recipient (or Keydemand) can accept or reject. A request cannot change after it is accepted, rejected, expired or closed. A listing that ends first closes its requests.

###### Flow 18 — Leads and "numbers viewed"

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. Each property page has a **Leads** area, split into contact requests and image requests.
2. The dashboard shows "Numbers you've viewed" (outbound) and "phone numbers viewed" (inbound, other users who revealed the agent's number).
3. Projects the agent enquired about are listed under "Projects enquired".

###### Flow 19 — Notifications centre

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. Open **Notifications** (the bell shows an unread count).
2. Each row has a message and, where relevant, a button (for example "View phone number", "Review request").
3. Mark one read, or **Mark all read.**
4. Empty state: "You're all caught up. New alerts will appear here."
5. Error state: "Couldn't load notifications. Something went wrong. Please try again."

**Edge cases:** notifications are fetched when the page opens, not pushed live. Only events with an In-app channel in section 4 land here. Toasts (for example welcome, property posted, subscription activated) are not stored, and WhatsApp-only alerts (for example new demands in your cities) do not appear here. Push alerts reach a phone only if a device token is registered at sign-in.

###### Flow 20 — Hit a free limit

- **Actor:** Free-tier agent.

1. The agent uses up the one free listing, or the five free reveals.
2. The action is refused with a clear message (see Flows 7, 12 and 15).
3. A paywall pop-up explains the benefits: unlimited listings, unlimited number reveals, priority matching, priority placement and lead insights.
4. A **"Free limit reached"** message is sent on WhatsApp, in-app, push and toast when the free listing is used up (email still to be decided), with a Subscribe button. The new rules have no message for running out of free reveals. It is sent at most once a week per limit.
5. The pop-up offers **Subscribe**, which opens the plan builder (hidden on iOS).

###### Flow 21 — Subscribe, pay and activate

- **Actor:** Registered agent.
- **Prerequisites:** Signed in as an agent, on Android or web, with an active account.

1. Open **Subscription** (or follow a paywall button).
2. Pick **cities** (Metro, Non-Metro, Rest of India, or Nationwide) and a **package**: Retail & F&B, Office, or both.
3. The summary shows the subtotal, 18% GST and the monthly total. Pan-India and Rest of India act as wildcards, and a wildcard covers its member cities. Cities in the same region are charged once.
4. Tap **Subscribe**. An order is created, then the Razorpay checkout opens.
5. The agent pays.
6. **On success:** payment is confirmed both by the app's return and by Razorpay's own confirmation. Coverage starts for 30 days. A Subscription activated message goes out on WhatsApp and by email (GST invoice PDF attached), with a toast and an Upload listing button.
7. **On failure:** the order stays unpaid. No notification is sent for a failed checkout; the Payment failed alert in section 4 covers auto-renewal only. The agent can retry. A "Your payment window was closed" message appears if checkout was abandoned.
8. A background check every 30 minutes settles a payment that succeeded but was not recorded.

**Rules**

- An agent can hold only **one** active subscription. A second purchase is refused: use add coverage, renew or cancel instead.
- A deactivated account cannot subscribe. The page explains whether the agent can reactivate, or must contact Keydemand.
- Managed Space cannot be bought.

**System side-effects:** listings that were hidden because of an earlier lapse come back when a plan is activated or renewed. The agent's state becomes "subscribed". The dashboard "Agent Subscription" banner disappears.

###### Flow 22 — Add or remove coverage

- **Actor:** Subscribed agent.

1. **Add now (paid):** the agent picks extra city and package pairs. A **prorated** quote shows the cost for the rest of the cycle only. They pay. The new coverage starts at once, and the cycle end date does not change. This purchase clears a pending cancellation.
2. **Remove:** removal is queued for the next cycle. The agent cannot remove everything: they must cancel instead. Removing a pair that is not held is refused.
3. A **next-month preview** shows what the next bill will be after pending changes.
4. Every change sends a "Plan changed" message on WhatsApp and by email (PDF invoice attached where applicable), with a toast and an Upload listing button.

**Edge cases:** an addition already covered by a wildcard or region shows a zero cost. If every addition is already held, nothing is charged, and no message is sent.

###### Flow 23 — Renew, cancel, reactivate and expiry

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. **Renew:** the plan auto-renews at the end of each cycle and charges for the merged coverage, including queued adds and removals, unless the agent turns auto-renew off. About 7 days before expiry an expiry notice is sent, and 3 days before a renewal reminder (both on WhatsApp, email, in-app and push). If the payment fails, a Payment failed alert asks the agent to update the payment method within [X] days.
2. **Cancel:** the plan stays active until the cycle ends, then pauses. A banner reads "Cancellation scheduled. Your plan stays active until [date]." A cancellation message is sent, with the last invoice.
3. **Reactivate (undo a cancellation):** while the plan is still active, the agent can undo the cancel.
4. **Cancelled then expired:** a cancelled plan cannot be renewed. The agent buys a fresh plan.
5. **Expiring soon:** the plan shows this state for the final 7 days.
6. **Expiry:** when the cycle ends without renewal, the plan becomes expired. A nightly job hides the agent's listings from the marketplace. A "Subscription expired" alert is sent (WhatsApp, email, in-app and push). The free limits apply again. Renewing or activating again unhides the listings.

**Edge cases:** deactivating the account does not unhide listings that the expiry job hid. They return only when the plan is renewed.

###### Flow 24 — My Plan, invoices and payment history

- **Actor:** Subscribed or lapsed agent.

1. Open **My Plan** to see coverage, cities, packages, renewal date and free-tier counters (free listing used, contact views used).
2. A **GST invoice** is ready to download after payment. It lists the subscriber, billing period, coverage lines and the price breakdown.
3. **Payment history** lists each payment and renewal bill.
4. An expired agent sees their previous coverage and an invoice from the lapsed plan.

**Edge cases:** the invoice PDF is always freshly produced, not cached. On iOS this page shows the plan and invoices only, with no buying options.

###### Flow 25 — Relationship manager and help requests

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. A relationship manager card exists only for enterprise brands, enterprise tenants and the RM-only roles. **Agents do not have one**.
2. Agents get help through the Contact page and FAQs. The notification page links to the Help Desk.
3. **Request help from my RM** is an enterprise feature and is not available to agents.

###### Flow 26 — Deactivate or reactivate the account

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. Open **Profile, Account, More**, then **Deactivate.**
2. The account is switched off. Listings and demands go down, with their open requests and any high-value lead.
3. The agent can still **sign in** to reactivate. All other writes are refused until they do. A banner and an "Account deactivated" gate explain this.
4. **Reactivate:** the listings and demands that this deactivation hid come back.
5. A Keydemand-initiated deactivation is different: the agent cannot sign in and is told to contact support.

**Edge cases:** listings hidden by an expired subscription stay hidden after reactivation, until the plan is renewed. A subscription cannot be bought while deactivated.

###### Flow 27 — Request account deletion

- **Actor:** Agent.

1. Open **Profile, Delete Account**, or the public Delete Account page. The page explains what is **taken offline** and what is **retained where required**.
2. Confirm the request. It is queued for Keydemand review, not wiped at once. Every message says "request".
3. The agent can **withdraw** the request ("Cancel your deletion request?") while it is pending.
4. A request already sent returns the same pending state.

**Edge cases:** a signed-out person can email the grievance officer instead.

---

##### 4. Notifications

**Channel key:** In-app = notification centre. Push = phone alert. WA = WhatsApp. Email = email. Toast = short on-screen message, not stored. "Notification" in the rules sheet means In-app and Push. Daily cap counts push, WhatsApp and email only. In-app and toast are exempt.

| Event | When it fires | Channels | CTA |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Welcome** | First time an agent registers on the platform | WA, Email, Toast | Complete profile |
| **Profile incomplete** | 24 hours after sign-up with an incomplete profile | WA, Toast | Complete profile |
| **Free listing available** | Free plan, with free listing(s) still left | In-app, Push, Toast | — |
| **Free plan exhausted** | Free listing limit used up | WA, In-app, Push, Toast (Email to be confirmed) | Subscribe |
| **Upsell prompt (not subscribed)** | Agent tries an action without an active subscription | Toast only, not stored | — |
| **Subscription activated** | Payment succeeds and the plan starts | WA, Email (PDF invoice attached), Toast | Upload listing |
| **Plan changed or cancelled** | Auto-renew turned off, plan cancelled or plan changed | WA, Email (PDF invoice attached where applicable), Toast | Upload listing |
| **Subscription about to expire** | About 7 days before the expiry date | WA, Email, In-app, Push | View details |
| **Renewal in 3 days** | 3 days before the expiry date | WA, Email, In-app, Push | View details |
| **Subscription expired** | Plan lapses without renewal; listings are paused | WA, Email, In-app, Push | Subscribe |
| **Payment failed** | Auto-renewal payment is declined | WA, Email, In-app, Push | Subscribe |
| **Property posted** | Agent posts a property (listing PDF generated) | WA, Email (property PDF attached), Toast | View property |
| **Property edited** | Agent edits a property | WA, Email (revised property PDF attached), Toast | View property |
| **Demand posted** | Agent posts a requirement | In-app, Push, Toast | — |
| **Demand edited** | Agent edits a requirement | In-app, Push, Toast | — |
| **New properties match your demand** | A new property matches a requirement the agent posted | WA (count of matches), In-app, Push, Toast | View relevancy |
| **New demands match your property** | A new requirement matches a property the agent listed | WA (count of matches), In-app, Push, Toast | View relevancy |
| **Your number was viewed** | Someone views the agent's number on a listing (daily lead signal) | WA, In-app, Push, Toast | View phone number |
| **Contact request answered** | Owner approves or declines the agent's request to view a number | WA, In-app, Push, Toast | View phone number |
| **Image request received** | Someone requests to view the agent's hidden images | WA, In-app, Push | Review request |
| **Image request answered** | Owner approves or declines the agent's image request | WA, In-app, Push | View property |
| **Project interest shown** | Agent shows interest in a project | In-app, Push, Toast | — |
| **New demands in subscribed cities** | New requirements posted today in cities the agent subscribed to | WA | Upload properties |
| **New demands in onboarding city (not subscribed)** | New requirements in the city added at onboarding, agent not subscribed | WA | Upload properties |

**Removed from the earlier version (not in the current rules):** property deactivated or deleted, demand deactivated or deleted, request closed or listing unavailable, listing is 90 days old, and the 6 pm daily summary. Matches, number views and new city demands are now sent directly instead of through the digest.

**Open points in the rules:** Free plan exhausted has no Email decision. The 7-day "about to expire" copy is the same as the 3-day renewal copy. Contact request answered has no declined text for the notification. The payment failed CTA says "Subscribe" rather than "Update payment method".

**Not sent to agents:** contact request received (brands), project interest received (developers and Keydemand), enterprise help and assignment (Keydemand), brand and occupier upsells.

---

##### 5. Limits and rules

| Rule | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Free listings | **1 in total**, shared across properties and demands |
| Free contact reveals | 5 in total, over the account's lifetime |
| Subscription packages | Retail & F&B, and Office |
| Subscription price per package per city, per month | Metro ₹1,000; Non-metro ₹750; Rest of India ₹1,000; Pan-India ₹5,000 |
| GST | 18%, added on top |
| Billing cycle | 30 days. Auto-renews at the end of each cycle unless the agent turns auto-renew off. If an auto-renewal payment fails, the agent has [X] days to update the payment method (to be decided). Note: this follows the new notification rules; the current build has no auto-debit (see Flow 23 and section 7) |
| Expiring-soon window | 7 days |
| Renewal reminder | 3 days before the expiry date (plus a 7-day expiry notice) |
| Plans held at once | 1 |
| Mid-cycle add | Prorated for the remaining days. Cycle date unchanged. |
| Coverage removal | Takes effect next cycle. Cannot remove all. |
| Cancellation | Plan runs to the end of the cycle. |
| Photos | JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB, at least one each of interior, exterior and front side |
| Documents | PDF, up to 10 MB |
| Videos | MP4 or MOV, up to 20 MB, up to 3 uploads and 3 links |
| Profile picture | JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB |
| Identity lock | Asset class, transaction type, city and location lock after the first response |
| Request expiry | 72 hours |
| Match visibility | 50% and above, within 3 km, same city |
| Managed Space posting | Lease only. Not subscription-eligible. |
| Listing audience for agent posts | Open to everyone (the audience control is for Keydemand posts only) |
| Demand audience for agent posts | Agents and Keydemand |
| Daily digest | None. Matches, number views and new city demands are sent as they happen (see section 4) |
| One-time code | 6 digits, 30-second resend gap, at most 3 sends in 5 minutes |

---

##### 6. Coverage checklist

**Web app routes covered:** Sign-in (Phone, Verify, Role, Register, Success), Home, Search, Explore Properties, View all properties, Property detail, Property post, Property edit, Demand post, Demand edit, Demand detail, Project detail, Dashboard, Profile, Profile edit, Saved, Notifications, Subscription, My Plan, Enterprise Solution, List your project, Delete account, Contact, FAQs, Cookie settings, Menu, Account, old v1 redirects, and the redirects for Favorites, Properties, Projects, Demands, Agents and Enterprise.

**Core API areas covered:** auth, users (profile, deactivate, reactivate, deletion request, devices), properties, demands, enquiries, contact unlock, subscriptions (pricing, orders, verify, coverage, cancel, reactivate, invoices, payments, previews), notifications, favourites, drafts, dashboard, home and leads, search, documents (PDF), upload, geo, assistance and webhooks (Razorpay).

**Not applicable to agents:** the Keydemand team routes, enterprise Formats and enterprise help requests, project creation, and Leads.

- **BR-PD-0553** — There is no daily digest for agents. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0554** — The one-time code is 6 digits with a 30-second resend gap and at most 3 sends in 5 minutes. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_

### Open questions / ambiguities in this doc
- Dashboard tab set was read from the page definition; the order should be confirmed in the running app (inferred).
- Whether the profile photo is saved at sign-up is unconfirmed (inferred: the server drops it at registration), while the sign-up form shows a photo picker.
- Older requirements say email is mandatory before posting; the code makes it optional (contradiction between sources).
- What the "show other agent demand" profile switch changes on screen is not documented (inferred).
- Mark sold or rented is allowed by the system but the web app shows no dedicated control (inferred).
- Re-moderation on edit is designed but not built, so edits never return to review.
- The 30-day automatic draft clean-up is not built.
- "Free plan exhausted" notification has no Email decision (to be confirmed); the new rules have no message for running out of free reveals.
- The 7-day "about to expire" copy is the same as the 3-day renewal copy.
- "Contact request answered" has no declined text for the notification.
- The Payment failed CTA says "Subscribe" rather than "Update payment method".
- The grace period "[X] days" to update the payment method after a failed auto-renewal is to be decided.
- Current build has no auto-debit, while the new notification rules describe auto-renewal charging (Flow 23 and section 7 referenced; section 7 lists no such note, only sources).
- The Billing cycle row says auto-renew applies, but the current build has no auto-debit, so auto-renewal behaviour as built is unclear.
- No notification is sent for a failed checkout; Payment failed covers auto-renewal only.
- The Flow 15 "Demand" row says reveal goes through a request "in some cases", without stating all cases.
- Section 1 says a free-tier agent's paywall prompts "priority matching, priority placement and lead insights" as benefits; no rule elsewhere defines these.
