## 09-control-panel-operator.md  [AUTHORITATIVE]
**Source:** Markdown file · ID `11E3iOB6Fix7-TFnHMCe4ZdyBKNZrChiD` · owner pradeepa.pv@futuristglobal.com · modified 2026-11-02 · 21,527 bytes · Drive folder "Phase 1 - Keydemanand Important documents › Product Documentation- Contains persona wise and Admin Panel tbsorted › personas" · an identical copy, "Copy of 09-control-panel-operator.md" (`1hxakwBdgIX0lrW6gKV2a3vYTXg48rJdE`, 2026-11-05, same byte size), sits in the "admin-panel" folder · read coverage: 100% (the file was downloaded and is copied below byte for byte, including the backslash escapes of the Markdown export; only the heading levels are nested).

### Content
#### Persona Flow — Control Panel Operator

> **Audience:** operations managers, customer success, HR (for access requests), QA and new operators. **Status date:** 2026-10-28. Live in production at admin.keydemand.ai. **Related:** [Admin Panel — Product Documentation](../admin-panel/01-product-documentation.md) (permissions, navigation, features) · [Admin Panel — Functional Flows](../admin-panel/02-functional-flows.md) (every step-by-step flow, numbered 1 to 37\) **Note:** The Control Panel operator is an internal staff persona. It is not one of the seven customer roles. Operators sign in with email and password, not phone and code.

---

##### 1\. Persona Snapshot

| Attribute | Detail |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Who they are** | Keydemand staff who run the marketplace behind the scenes: operations, support, data entry, leadership, engineering |
| **How they sign in** | Email and password, plus a 6-digit emailed code in production |
| **How they are created** | A super admin or admin adds them. There is no sign-up. |
| **What they own** | Customer accounts, listing quality, lead routing, subscriptions, access control and platform health |
| **What they never do** | Browse as a customer. Their view is a management view with every audience visible. |
| **Account limits** | Two active super admins at most. Sessions end after 24 hours idle. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes. |
| **Distinct from** | Keydemand team members who use the customer app (relationship managers and others). Operators manage them but are a separate account type. |

###### Operator Types

| Operator Type | Typical Person | Day-to-Day Focus |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Super Admin** | Tech lead, business head | Staff security, system settings, anything |
| **Admin** | Operations manager | Customers, listings, leads, subscriptions, staff (but not super admins) |
| **Contributor** | Data-entry staff | Post and edit listings and projects, bulk upload, view users |
| **Business Viewer** | Leadership, finance | Dashboard and Business Insights, with export |
| **Tech Viewer** | Engineers, support | Technical Insights, with export |
| **Custom** | Any | Whatever a role was built to allow |

---

##### 2\. What Each Operator Type Sees

✅ \= the screen appears in the sidebar. ❌ \= it does not.

| Screen | Super Admin | Admin | Contributor | Business Viewer | Tech Viewer |
| :---- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Dashboard** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| **User Management** (agents, brands, tenants, developers, operators, Keydemand team) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (view only) | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Enterprise** (brands, tenants) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (view only) | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Listing Management** (properties, demands) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (view and edit) | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Projects** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (view, add, edit) | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Bulk Upload** | ✅ upload and review | ✅ upload and review | ✅ upload only | ❌ | ❌ |
| **V1 Completion Queue** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Subscription Mgmt** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **High Value Leads** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Enquiries** (marketing, listing leads, account deletions) | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Control Panel Users** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Email Domains** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **App Insights — Business** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |
| **App Insights — Technical** | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| **Observability** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Analytics** (placeholder) | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Bell and Recent Activity** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

> A custom role sees exactly the screens its permissions open. The full permission matrix is in section 2.4 of the product documentation.

---

##### 3\. End-to-End Journey Map

The journey of an operator across a working day, with a link to the detailed flow for each step.

| Stage | What the Operator Does | Detailed Flow |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Get access** | A super admin or admin creates the account. The operator receives a one-time password. | Flow 6 |
| **First sign-in** | Signs in, sets a strong password, then enters an emailed code if required. | Flows 2, 3 |
| **Start the day** | Reads the morning email (08:00 India time) and opens the Dashboard. | Flows 31, 34 |
| **Process new customers** | Creates accounts for developers, operators, enterprise brands and tenants. | Flows 9 to 15 |
| **Handle inbound interest** | Assigns marketing enquiries and converts onboarding leads. | Flow 23 |
| **Quality-check listings** | Approves or rejects listings in the queue, and reviews bulk uploads. | Flows 19, 21 |
| **Post for customers** | Posts properties, demands, projects and centres on a customer's behalf. | Flows 16 to 18 |
| **Route high-value demands** | Assigns and releases high-value leads. | Flow 22 |
| **Support and corrections** | Edits listings, changes agent plans, processes deletion requests. | Flows 20, 25, 27 |
| **Watch the platform** | Reads Business or Technical Insights and exports a report. | Flow 32 |
| **Troubleshoot (super admin)** | Raises a log level for a short time. | Flow 33 |
| **End the day** | Signs out, or stays signed in under the 24-hour idle rule. | Flow 5 |

---

##### 4\. Condensed Flows by Operator Type

###### 4.1 Super Admin

| Goal | Condensed Steps | Full Flow |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Add or remove staff | Open Control Panel Users, add or disable, choose a role | 6, 7 |
| Build a custom role | Tick permissions grouped by module | 8 |
| Reset someone's access | Reset credentials, a one-time password is emailed | 7 |
| Edit a built-in role | Change its permissions (super admin only) | 8 |
| Change logging for troubleshooting | Pick a service, level, reason and expiry | 33 |
| Set up the daily error email | Recipients, on or off, send even when clean | 33 |
| Decide a hand-over for a leaver | Pick a successor, or hold with an admin | 13 |
| Everything an admin does | See the admin list | — |

**Limits for a super admin:** at most two active super admins. The last active super admin cannot be disabled, deleted or demoted. Two-factor is controlled from the cloud console by ops, not here.

###### 4.2 Admin

| Goal | Condensed Steps | Full Flow |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Onboard a developer or operator | Create the account, then post their project or centre | 12, 18 |
| Onboard an enterprise brand | Create, add users, assign POC, add formats, post demands | 14, 15 |
| Promote or demote a tenant or brand | Convert, optionally set the POC in the same step | 14 |
| Manage Keydemand staff | Create, set permissions, hand over work, deactivate | 13 |
| Moderate listings | Approve, or reject with a reason | 19 |
| Bulk load listings and approve them | Validate, create for review, review, approve | 21 |
| Run high-value leads | Define rules, switch cities, assign, release | 22 |
| Handle enquiries and deletions | Assign, change status, convert, process or decline | 23, 25 |
| Sell and adjust plans | Grant free plans, extend, cancel, revoke, change coverage | 27 |
| Set prices and cities | Edit rates, regions and thresholds | 26 |
| Control signup domains | Add block or allow rules | 28 |
| Manage staff (not super admins) | Create, disable, reset, build custom roles | 6 to 8 |
| Review the platform | Dashboard, Business and Technical Insights, export | 31, 32 |

**Limits for an admin:** cannot create, promote, demote, disable or reset a super admin. Cannot delete an operator. Cannot edit built-in roles. Cannot grant a permission they do not hold. Cannot see Observability.

###### 4.3 Contributor

| Goal | Condensed Steps | Full Flow |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Post a property or demand for a customer | Open the post form, choose who it is for, fill and save | 16, 17 |
| Post a project or centre | From the developer or operator page | 18 |
| Edit listings and projects | Use the shared edit forms | 20 |
| Upload a sheet in bulk | Pick a variant, upload, fix errors, create for review | 21 |
| Fix migrated records | Work the V1 completion queue | 29 |
| Look up users and the dashboard | Read-only | 9, 31 |

**Limits for a contributor:** cannot approve or reject bulk rows (the reviewer does), cannot delete listings or users, cannot enable or disable listings, and cannot touch pricing, leads or staff. Because approve and reject sit under "Listings — edit", a contributor can moderate single listings in the queue.

###### 4.4 Business Viewer

| Goal | Condensed Steps | Full Flow |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Read the day's numbers | Open the Dashboard | 31 |
| Study growth, revenue, marketplace and engagement | Open Business Insights, set range and filters | 32 |
| Share findings | Export CSV or Excel | 32 |
| Receive the morning email | Only if also an admin or super admin | 34 |

**Limits for a business viewer:** read only. No user or listing screens. No Technical Insights.

###### 4.5 Tech Viewer

| Goal | Condensed Steps | Full Flow |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Check platform health | Open Technical Insights, view Health and Errors | 32 |
| Investigate slowness | API Performance, Dependencies, Jobs | 32 |
| Check security and payments pipelines | Auth and Security, Payments Pipeline | 32 |
| See current feature settings | Runtime Config (read-only) | 32 |
| Export a view | CSV or Excel | 32 |

**Limits for a tech viewer:** cannot change log levels (super admin only). No Dashboard, Business Insights or customer screens.

###### 4.6 Custom Role Holder

Their journey follows whichever flows their permissions open. The role editor groups permissions by module: Dashboard, Users, Listings, Projects, Bulk Upload, Subscriptions, High Value Leads, Formats, Enquiries, Control Panel Users and App Insights.

---

##### 5\. Common Scenarios

###### 5.1 "I cannot sign in"

| Cause | What the Operator Sees | What to Do |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Wrong password | An error | Retry. After 5 wrong attempts the account locks for 15 minutes. |
| Account disabled | A "disabled" message | Ask an admin to enable the account |
| No code arrives | The code screen, but nothing in the inbox | Wait 60 seconds and resend (up to 3 times). Check spam. On DEV and SIT email is held on purpose. |
| Code expired or wrong | A message with attempts remaining | Request a new code, or sign in again |
| Forgot password | Self-service is off in production | Ask a super admin to reset credentials |
| Signed out suddenly | Back at sign-in | Likely a password change, role change, disable or 24-hour idle limit |

###### 5.2 "I cannot see a screen"

The sidebar only shows what the role allows. Ask an admin to review the role, or to assign a different one. A permission change takes effect on the operator's next click, without signing out.

###### 5.3 "I need to leave or hand over my work"

Operators do not hand over work. Keydemand team members who hold accounts and listings do (Flow 13). An operator holding a parked hand-over for someone else cannot be deleted until it is completed.

---

##### 6\. Notifications and Emails Operators Receive

| Email or Notice | When | Who Gets It |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **One-time password** | Account created, or credentials reset | The operator |
| **Sign-in code** | Each sign-in where two-factor is on | The operator |
| **Password reset code** | Forgot password (off in production) | The operator |
| **Security alert** | New device or location, super admin sign-in, repeated failures, password change, credential reset, role or permission change | The operator and the DevOps group (UAT and production) |
| **Role change notice** | Their role changed | The operator |
| **Daily newsletter** | 08:00 India time | Active super admins and admins |
| **Daily error digest** | 08:30 India time | Configured recipients (usually super admins and DevOps) |
| **Marketing lead assigned** | A lead is assigned to a Keydemand member | In-app, to the assigned team member |
| **High-value lead assigned, reassigned or withdrawn** | Rule changes, approval, assignment | In-app, to the assigned team members |
| **Bell** | Recent enquiries and leads, plus the admin team activity notices listed below | The signed-in operator, in the header |

All operator emails are marked with the environment, for example "\[PROD\]", and replies go to the monitored contact inbox.

###### **Admin Team Activity Notifications**

These notices tell the admin team about new sign-ups, enquiries, leads, subscriptions, deletion requests and listing activity. Recipients, permission filtering and send times for the daily summaries are still to be confirmed (see Section 9). Emails carry the environment tag, as above.

---

##### 7\. Limits and Guardrails

| Guardrail | Detail |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Session** | 30-minute access that renews quietly. 24-hour idle limit. |
| **Sign-in** | 5 wrong passwords lock for 15 minutes. 5 wrong codes void a code. 5 codes in 15 minutes is the cap. |
| **Password** | At least 6 characters with one uppercase letter, one number and one special character. |
| **Super admins** | At most two active. Fixed to two named people today. |
| **Staff changes** | Only a super admin can touch super admins, built-in roles and operator deletion. |
| **No self-harm** | Cannot disable or delete yourself. |
| **Role limits** | Cannot grant a permission you do not hold. |
| **Posting** | Panel posts go live at once, already approved. Same identity rules as the customer app. |
| **Bulk** | 5 MB, 2,000 rows, 120 columns. 2 active jobs per person, 5 overall. Preview expires after 48 hours. |
| **Insights** | Business ranges up to 366 days (operations 90, day granularity 92). Technical up to 7 days. Export includes the whole view. |
| **Privacy in Insights** | Aggregates only. Groups under 5 show as "under 5". |
| **Logging changes** | Debug and trace expire within 240 minutes. A reason is required for every change. |
| **Everything is logged** | Data changes, refusals, exports and sign-ins. |

---

| Sign-in, code step, forced password change, forgot password, session handling | Flows 1 to 5 |
| Staff, roles, protections | Flows 6 to 8 |
| User management for every customer type | Flows 9 to 15 |
| Listings, moderation, bulk upload | Flows 16 to 21 |
| Leads, enquiries, deletions | Flows 22 to 25 |
| Subscriptions, cities, pricing | Flows 26, 27 |
| Email-domain rules, migration queue, relevance, formats | Flows 28 to 30 |
| Dashboard, Insights, Observability, newsletter, PDF, bell, audit | Flows 31 to 37 |

### Business rules extracted
- **BR-PD-2108** — The Control Panel operator is an internal staff persona and not one of the seven customer roles. _(Header note)_
- **BR-PD-2109** — Operators sign in with email and password, not phone and code. _(Header note; 1. Persona Snapshot)_
- **BR-PD-2110** — In production, sign-in also needs a 6-digit emailed code. _(1. Persona Snapshot)_
- **BR-PD-2111** — Operators are added by a super admin or admin; there is no sign-up. _(1. Persona Snapshot)_
- **BR-PD-2112** — Operators never browse as a customer; their view is a management view with every audience visible. _(1. Persona Snapshot)_
- **BR-PD-2113** — Account limits: at most two active super admins, sessions end after 24 hours idle, five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes. _(1. Persona Snapshot)_
- **BR-PD-2114** — Keydemand team members who use the customer app are a separate account type from operators, but operators manage them. _(1. Persona Snapshot)_
- **BR-PD-2115** — Operator types: Super Admin, Admin, Contributor, Business Viewer, Tech Viewer, Custom. _(1. Operator Types)_

### Open questions / ambiguities in this doc
- Analytics screen is a placeholder only.
- Content management and site-down are reserved permissions, not built.
- Operator self-service profile and sessions screen is not built; no screen lists an operator's own devices or sessions, only "sign out everywhere" exists.
- Audit viewer: the trail is recorded but no screen reads it.
- Contributor approval scope: that a contributor can approve/reject single listings follows from the permission rules, was not tested in the running app, and whether it is intended is a product question.
- Editable fields per role on every page are taken from the permission rules and not tested screen by screen.
- Production newsletter recipients (active super admins and admins) were not checked against live values.
- Admin team activity notification recipients: which roles receive them and whether each notice is filtered by the operator's permissions is not yet decided.
- Daily summary emails (requirements, properties, projects) overlap with the 08:00 newsletter; send time and whether they replace, join or sit alongside it is not yet decided.
- Admin team activity notifications live status: added from the new spec, not checked in the running app.
- Status date 2026-10-28 predates the admin-team notification spec (2026-11-03), yet Section 6 includes it; the persona doc and the other two docs (dated 2026-11-05) differ in status date.
- Conflict with Functional Flows 38 / Product Documentation 5.3: pending sign-up subject here includes "[Mobile number]" but not there; agent subscribed body wording differs.
- Conflict: "Fixed to two named people today" (here, Section 7) and "two people in every environment" (Product Documentation 1) agree, but neither names who holds the seats.
- Ambiguity: "5 codes in 15 minutes is the cap" here versus Functional Flows 2 "more than 5 codes in 15 minutes" is refused.
- Ambiguity: Section 4.3 lists "Look up users" for Contributor as Flows 9, 31, but Section 2 says Enterprise is view only; the Users permission for view does not itself include Enterprise detail edit.

### Open questions / ambiguities in this doc
- **Doc error or app defect?** The lists record each difference but not which side is right. Each row needs triage: correct the journey document, or log a defect.
- **Keydemand Team journey is only partly checked (35% confidence).** Its signed-in team screens are not captured: 11 steps need test team members on SIT, and creating them needs approval.
- **Source text.** The review did not compare the journey text word for word with the earlier Drive files ("copied by reading"). On 2026-11-06 six of the eight journeys were compared word for word with the build folder's copy of the earlier text for this knowledge base (results in each journey's Source line); the Agent and Brand journeys were not, and no journey was compared byte for byte with the earlier Drive file.
- **Counts.** The Overview tab totals 266 differences; the working files hold 270 difference rows (the Developer files contain 2 repeated rows, and rows that record a passed check are counted here too).
- **Privacy on screenshots.** Test phone numbers are visible on Managed Space Tenant shots (6 Control Panel, 2 web) and on 4 Unregistered User code-entry shots; the blur-or-keep decision is open. Control Panel list screens show other SIT records' names, not confirmed as test data.
- **SIT only.** Everything was observed on SIT. Old V1 links could not be tested there, and production may differ.
- **Test data left on SIT** is listed in the "SIT test data" tab; clean-up is pending (OP66 and PRJ43 are reused across personas).

### Conflicts across docs in this group
1. **Daily digest.** The Agent journey says there is no daily digest and notifications are sent as they happen; the product overview and the Brand journey describe a digest at 18:00 / 6 pm.
2. **Phone-number reveal for tenants.** The Office Tenant and Managed Space Tenant journeys describe an instant reveal with no approval inbox, but their notification tables still carry "Approve to share your number" wording.
3. **Admin-team notifications, build status.** Functional Flows, Flow 38: not in the code at all (specification only). Product Documentation 5.3: "build status to be confirmed". Operator persona flow: live status not checked.
4. **Pending sign-up email subject.** Product Documentation 5.3 and Flow 38 use "[User type]"; the operator persona flow uses "[User type], [Mobile number]".
5. **"Agent subscribed" email body** is worded differently in Flow 38 and in Product Documentation 5.3 / the operator persona flow.
6. **Recent Activity.** Product Documentation 4.19 limits it to marketing enquiries and listing leads; Flow 36 says "View all" also lists admin-team notifications.
7. **Sign-in code cap.** Flow 2 refuses "more than 5 codes in 15 minutes"; the operator persona flow and the Product Documentation give 5 codes in 15 minutes as the cap.
8. **Dates.** The operator persona flow is dated 2026-10-28 but includes the notification specification of 2026-11-03.
9. **Sections named in a Contents list but missing from the body.** Product overview: "6. Open Questions & Gaps". Unregistered journey: section 7 (open questions). Keydemand Team journey: "7. Open questions / gaps / not built" (the body goes straight to the source appendix). Admin Product Documentation: item 9 under 9.3 is cut off mid-sentence.
